department: Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering, FAMU-FSU College of Engineering

deadline.value: Assistantship applicants are asked to apply for Fall by 15 January, but the page gives no year.
deadline.quote: Students seeking assistantships and other financial aid should apply for Fall semester admissions no later than 15th of January

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The college's PhD programs offer competitive funding packages to newly admitted students.
funding.quote: The FAMU-FSU College of Engineering Ph.D. programs offer competitive funding packages for newly admitted students

entry_route.value: The PhD accepts an undergraduate or a graduate GPA of 3.0 or higher.
entry_route.quote: An undergraduate upper-division GPA or graduate GPA of 3.0 (on a 4.0 scale) or higher

notes: Aerospace PhD: 'FAMU or FSU is not yet authorized to enroll F-1 international students in either the Masters or Doctoral degree program in Aerospace Engineering.' Indian applicants on F-1 should not apply to the aerospace PhD on this page. The department also has a Graduate Faculty Preference Form in the application.
